text: The purpose of this report is to remove a director from the Uptown Yonge (BIA) Board of Management, in accordance with the requirements of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 19, Business Improvement Areas. The Uptown Yonge BIA falls within two Community Council boundaries.

City Council on November 8 and 9, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, remove the following director from the Uptown Yonge Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below: Lokash, Stephen
